"""Audit all continuation rows, durable calls, saved prefix and final Adam/EMA state."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from v175_postprocess import REPO, ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once

from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

plan, post = context()
result = read(ROOT / "train-result-v1.json")
trace = [json.loads(s) for s in (ROOT / "train-trace-v1.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(trace) == 9000 and trace == result["trace"]
assert result["status"].startswith("completed")
cache = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
eligible = read(plan["clean_sensor_preflight"]["path"])["rows"]
old = read(plan["initial_training"]["path"])["trace"]
assert len(cache) == len(units) == len(eligible) == len(old) == 1000

# Recheck each unique original array/parent binding once. The 8,073 new arrays
# were streamed; their complete posthoc byte archive does not exist.
source_inputs = 0
for index, (item, unit, permitted) in enumerate(zip(cache, units, eligible, strict=True)):
    assert item["step"] == unit["step"] == permitted["step"] == index + 1
    assert item["arrays"] == unit["batch"] == permitted["arrays"]
    assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
    assert ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
    arrays = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
    assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == item["inputs"]
    assert fingerprint(np.load(item["parent"]["path"])) == item["parent_values"]
    expected_units = np.maximum(
        np.sqrt(np.asarray(item["metadata"]["sensor"].get("increment_mean_variance", []), np.float32)),
        np.float32(2 / 65535),
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(expected_units, np.asarray(unit["candidate_units_FP32"], np.float32))
    assert permitted["noisy"] == bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0))
    source_inputs += len(arrays)

events = [json.loads(s) for s in (ROOT / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
from v175_training_trace_audit import validate_trace
validated = validate_trace(trace, cache, units, eligible, old, events, plan)
counts, parent_counts, cursor, updates, skips, fresh, cached, totals, masks, observed_arguments, poisson, gaussian, domains, seeds, maximum_difference = [validated[k] for k in ["counts", "parent_counts", "cursor", "updates", "skips", "fresh", "cached", "totals", "masks", "observed_arguments", "poisson", "gaussian", "domains", "seeds", "maximum_difference"]]
assert cursor == len(events) == 2 * 8073 + 2 * 8100
assert updates == 8100 and skips == 900 and fresh == 8073 and cached == 27
assert result["counts"] == counts and result["parent_counts"] == parent_counts == dict(parent=8075, DINO=8075)
assert result["sensor_Poisson_calls"] == poisson and result["sensor_Gaussian_calls"] == gaussian == 8073
assert result["training_images"] == 32400 and result["total_training_images_including_V172"] == 36000
assert result["total_optimizer_updates"] == 9000 and result["updates"] == updates

saved = saved_bytes = 0
for row in trace[:8]:
    if not row["noisy"]:
        continue
    item = cache[row["cache_step"] - 1]
    for field in ["saved_inputs", "saved_parent"]:
        assert ref(row[field]["path"]) == row[field]
        saved_bytes += Path(row[field]["path"]).stat().st_size
    arrays = dict(np.load(row["saved_inputs"]["path"]))
    parent = np.load(row["saved_parent"]["path"])
    assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == row["inputs"] and fingerprint(parent) == row["parent_values"]
    shot, read_noise = [item["metadata"]["noise"][k] for k in ["shot", "read"]]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(arrays["variance"], np.maximum(arrays["packed"].astype(np.float64), 0) * shot + read_noise, rtol=2e-7, atol=1e-12)
    clean = np.stack([np.stack([rgb[int(c), k // 2::2, k % 2::2] for k, c in enumerate(layout)]) for rgb, layout in zip(arrays["target"].clip(min=0), arrays["colors"], strict=True)])
    for first, second in arrays["pair_indices"]:
        identical = clean[first] == clean[second]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(arrays["packed"][first][identical], arrays["packed"][second][identical])
    saved += 1
assert saved == 7

restoration = read(ROOT / "checkpoint-restoration-v1.json")
assert all(restoration[k] for k in ["model_exact", "optimizer_exact", "EMA_exact", "CPU_RNG_exact", "CUDA_RNG_exact"])
assert restoration["continued_at_step"] == 1009 and restoration["repeated_prefix_forwards"] == 0
for binding in result["checkpoints"]:
    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
state = torch.load(result["final_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
initial = torch.load(plan["initial_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
assert state["step"] == 10000 and state["updates"] == 8100 and state["total_updates"] == 9000
assert state["counts"] == counts and state["parent_counts"] == parent_counts and state["skipped"] == 900
assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 141
assert all(float(s["step"]) == 9000 and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in s.values()) for s in state["optimizer"]["state"].values())
assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*state["models"].values(), *state["ema"].values()])
assert all(value > 0 for value in result["parameter_maximum_gradients"].values())
frozen = [k for k in state["models"] if k.startswith("frozen.")]
assert len(frozen) == 47 and all(torch.equal(state["models"][k], initial["models"][k]) for k in frozen)
module = LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan["module_config"])
module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
raw_hash = model_hash(module)
module.network.load_state_dict(state["ema"], strict=True)
EMA_hash = model_hash(module)
assert model_hash(module.frozen) == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"] == result["frozen_module_hash"]
assert result["frozen_weights_unchanged"] and result["RNG_unchanged"] and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
write_once(ROOT / "training-audit-v1.json", dict(status="pass-all9000-continuation-bindings-events-totals-and-final-states",
    plan=ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"), training=ref(ROOT / "train-result-v1.json"), training_journal=ref(ROOT / "train-trace-v1.jsonl"),
    training_forward_journal=ref(ROOT / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl"), cached_batches_checked=1000,
    cached_input_fingerprints_checked=source_inputs, unique_cached_parent_bindings_checked=1000, continuation_rows_checked=9000,
    unit_table_bindings_checked=9000, updates=updates, total_optimizer_updates_including_V172=9000, ADC_skips=skips,
    fresh_sensor_batches=fresh, retained_cached_noisy_batches=cached, actual_parent_argument_fingerprints_checked=observed_arguments,
    training_forward_events_checked=len(events), FP32_loss_totals_checked=totals, maximum_loss_total_difference=maximum_difference,
    inherited_target_mask_fingerprints_checked=masks, source_domains=dict(domains), unique_fresh_sensor_seeds=len(seeds),
    sensor_Poisson_calls=poisson, sensor_Gaussian_calls=gaussian, saved_prefix_batches_checked=saved, saved_prefix_bytes=saved_bytes,
    strict_final_raw_and_EMA_states=2, raw_module_hash=raw_hash, EMA_module_hash=EMA_hash, final_Adam_states=141,
    actual_final_Adam_step=9000, frozen47_state_tensors_exact_initial=True, checkpoint_restoration=restoration,
    new_neural_forwards=0, new_sensor_noise_draws=0, CUDA_initialized=False, source=source(__file__),
    scope="All9000 source/target/pair-unit mappings,durable parent/matching events,8100 actual FP32 loss totals and inherited clean masks checked. Original1000 cached observations/parents rehashed once. New8073 full-array archive was not retained;posthoc physical variance/pair equality checks cover only seven saved fresh prefix batches. Other fresh rows have stateless seeds,actual observed parent-argument/output fingerprints and unchanged-source proof,not a posthoc full-array audit. No noise regenerated or neural forwards repeated. Final141 Adam states are at step9000,including900 inherited V172 updates. Exact checkpoint restoration does not promise bit-exact retraining."))
print("PASS9000 rows;8100 FP32 loss totals;8073 fresh parent bindings;141 Adam states at9000;zero new forwards/noise")
